subject.title: fix(channels): honor configured read target policies

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this host-attested current-turn authority and fail-closed channel-owner policy as the canonical cross-channel read and action contract?
rationale: The implementation appears coherent, but it intentionally changes security authority, public plugin context, accepted targets, and provider action availability; those compatibility and product-boundary choices require maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept after owner sign-off
options.body: Land the exact head after core and affected channel owners confirm external-plugin, fresh-setup, and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Narrow the contract
options.body: Split Google Chat or public Plugin SDK changes that maintainers do not want to accept with the shared authorization patch.

options.title: Pause the rollout
options.body: Keep current behavior while designing a narrower authority model if the cross-channel contract is not acceptable.

recommendation.title: Accept after owner sign-off
recommendation.body: Land the exact head after core and affected channel owners confirm external-plugin, fresh-setup, and upgrade behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main ownership of the central plugin tool-resolution boundary makes this the clearest available routing owner for the contract decision.
